text:
Maya: Heads-up — I'm creating an A/B in Console for rerank service (rerank-v2 quantized). Need routing + guard rules. Who owns the Console experiment UI?
Lee: I can wire the UI, but need the exact API shapes/edge cases. sticky sessions? rollout ramps?
David: We should do sticky_by user_id and support explicit whitelists for dogfood. Also need clear guard semantics: rollback vs pause.
Maya: Agreed on sticky_by user_id. Guard semantics: immediate rollback action on threshold breach (we can later add pause). Thresholds I had in mind: error_rate > 1.5% over 5m or p95 latency > 600ms over 5m.
Sara: For ramps I recommend micro-canary: 0.5% -> 5% -> 20% with configurable wait windows. Also add an internal-only cohort (email domain) to bootstrap. :thumbsup:
Lee: UI needs an example rule object to render the variant table + guard cards. Can someone paste a canonical example?
David: Putting one here (for UI and backend contract):
```json
{
  "experiment": "rerank-v2-quant-test",
  "variants": [
    {"name": "control", "model": "rerank-v1", "traffic": 94},
    {"name": "quant", "model": "rerank-v2-8bit", "traffic": 6}
  ],
  "sticky_by": ["user_id"],
  "whitelist": {"emails": ["eng+qa@redwood.com"], "domains": ["redwood.com"]},
  "ramps": [
    {"after": "2m", "to": 5},
    {"after": "30m", "to": 20},
    {"after": "4h", "to": 50}
  ],
  "guards": [
    {"metric": "request_error_rate", "window": "5m", "threshold": 0.015, "action": "rollback"},
    {"metric": "p95_latency_ms", "window": "5m", "threshold": 600, "action": "rollback"}
  ],
  "fallback": "control",
  "notes": "sticky hashing should use murmur3(user_id) mod 10000 for consistent splits"
}
```
Maya: Nice. Two clarifications: 1) we need an explicit "grace" period after a ramp step (so guards are suppressed for X minutes post-change). 2) fallback should be explicit model name not just variant id.
Lee: UI will surface grace as an optional field. For rendering splits I'll support both percentage and per-10k buckets based on the murmur3 note.
Sara: Telemetry — make sure the experiment tags appear on traces and logs (experiment_id + variant) so SRE can slice. Also add metrics ingestion to the experiment dashboard (errors, latency, tokens).
David: Agree. Also ensure we have quota exclusions: internal dev traffic shouldn't count towards production quotas. ops-bot, can we add an internal flag?
ops-bot: created experiment "exp_20260315_01" with status DRAFT and id exp_20260315_01. Set owner=Maya. :white_check_mark:
Maya: Perfect. Next steps: Lee to implement UI form fields (sticky_by, whitelist, ramps, guards, grace, fallback). David to land backend contract + experiment creation API. Sara to draft dashboard tiles and telemetry tags. I'll author an eval prompt set to catch ranking regressions.
Lee: I'll push a design PR by EOD and include UX for guard explanations.
David: I'll mock the API response (exp payload + validation errors) and share a swagger snippet.
Sara: Will create a dashboard draft and add a canary alert rule panel.
Maya: Thanks team — flag me if anything blocks. :rocket:
Lee: quick question — should the UI show a preview of the actual routing rule (DSL) before you commit? I think yes.
David: yes show the DSL + human-readable summary. Also show estimated RPS to new variant based on recent traffic.
Maya: Agreed. That preview will help non-engineers understand the changes.

Maya: Closing loop — we'll run the micro-canary tomorrow morning. Will post results in #product afterwards. :eyes:
